budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Each grower earns fruit only from ripe own plots. They share three mobile pollinators, three circulating seeds and 22 initial water units, creating individual incentives to coordinate flowering and habitat care while competing for resources and six season harvest slots.
task.natural_termination: The sixth accepted harvest ends the season; cyclic transaction order allocates a final scarce harvest slot without exceeding six. The season can also end when no water remains in any storage and no ripe fruit remains. Otherwise time ends at 96 transitions.
task.interaction: Every flowering plot changes the shared pollinators destination set. A bee carries the last visited owner label; visiting a different owner flower raises its future fruit from one to three. Habitat water restores bee visit capacity and is shared across owners. Water draws, neighbor irrigation and physical seed gifts transfer actual scarce resources; there is no cooperation-label reward.
task.observation_access: The world is fully observable: all positions, owners, seed/water balances, growth clocks, pollination/fruit state, pollinator memory/targets, habitat reserves and tank balance are public native fields. Own role is an explicit one-hot. Every scene entity uses true public visibility; there is no private renderer-only plant or bee state.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Seed planted into plot on this transition
Pollinator reached and visited a flower
Grower added water to habitat reserve
Grower gave a seed to an adjacent owner

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
